questions.explanation:
Learning disability in ICD10 is synonymous with mental retardation (DSM) and also called intellectual disability. It  isde�ned in DSM-5 in
terms of the IQ being less than 70. The presentation is in early life within the developmental period that DSM stipulates as up to 18 years of
age but is not speci�ed by ICD. It is associated with de�cits in social and adaptive functioning. General intellectual functioning is determined
by the use of standardized tests of intelligence.
Mild LD has IQ in the range 50-69, moderate with a range 35-49, severe in the range 20-34, and profound being below 20. Borderline
intellectual functioning, according to DSM-5, is not within the diagnostic boundary of mental retardation. It refers to a full-scale IQ in the
range of 71 to 84.

questions.emi_instruction: Identify the estimated prevalence of mental health problems from population-based studies of adults with learning disability
questions.explanation:
1) Psychotic disorders, particularly schizophrenia, appear to be more common in those who also have a learning disability. The rate is raised
threefold over the general population. Most studies report a prevalence of 3 to 3.5 percent for schizophrenia in learning disabled
population.

questions.emi_instruction: Identify the estimated prevalence of mental health problems from population-based studies of adults with learning disability
questions.explanation:
2) The prevalence of depression is around 2-4%. Depressed mood and vegetative symptoms are the most striking symptoms, even though
complaints of depression are not always expressed. A depressive mood is not verbalized, particularly among individuals at a lower
intelligence level, but may well be observable.

questions.emi_instruction: Identify the estimated prevalence of mental health problems from population-based studies of adults with learning disability
questions.explanation:
3) Epilepsy is more prevalent and harder to diagnose and treat in people with mental retardation than in those with normal intellect.
Population-based studies have revealed that mental retardation occurs in at least 30 to 40 percent of individuals with epilepsy while the
prevalence of epilepsy in the mentally retarded population is about 20 to 25 percent. It is higher in severe (30-50%) than mild (15-20%) LD.

questions.emi_instruction: Identify the estimated prevalence of mental health problems from population-based studies of adults with learning disability
questions.explanation:
4) Autistic spectrum disorder and ADHD is increasingly common with increasing severity of LD. It is often a prominent feature in children
with LD (up to 20%). Stimulants may help in persons with mild LD with apparent symptoms, but has no clear e�cacy in severe-profound LD.

questions.emi_instruction: Identify the estimated prevalence of mental health problems from population-based studies of adults with learning disability
questions.explanation:
5) The self-injurious behaviour occurs in approximately 20% of adults with learning disability and up to 50% in those requiring institutional
care. The self-injurious behaviour occurs more often among persons with moderate and severe mental retardation (IQ < 50). This type of
behaviour occurs most frequently between the ages of 10 and 30, with a peak between 15 and 20 years of age.

and Rett syndrome (90%). In people with Down syndrome the frequency of epilepsy is 5 to 10 percent. There is an age-related bimodal
distribution with about 40 percent of seizures starting before the age of 1 year and another 40 percent starting after the third decade.

questions.explanation:
1) Homocystinuria is inherited as an autosomal recessive trait. Homocystinuria has several common features with Marfan syndrome. In
Marfan syndrome, the joints tend to be "loose," but in homocystinuria the joints tend to be "tight". The symptoms may occur as mildly
delayed development or in some cases failure to thrive. The person may develop increasing visual problems that may lead to the diagnosis
of this condition. Chest deformities (pectus excavatum, pectus carinatum), high arched feet, tall & thin build, long limbs, mild mental
retardation, near sightedness, dislocated lens of the eye are other associated features.
